resources.string: Followed channels and your own emotes will no longer be available.
All saved playback positions will be lost.
Scan the code with the Twitch app to follow or unfollow the channel. Then close with Back.
Scan the code to open this channel\'s chat on your phone.
Nobody is streaming in this category right now.
Make the Language row the first row inside Game category
Review at the start of a month
In the first days of a month the home screen shows a card with your last 30 days, once.
Counts which channels you watch and for how long, only on this device and not in backups. The Statistics button on the home screen shows it; deleting is done there. A session counts from one minute.
Open the last channel on start

When the app starts, the stream you watched last opens straight away if it is live; otherwise you land on the home screen. Back from the player leads to the home screen. Only streams started while this is on are remembered, and only on this device.
You can trigger a Refresh by long pressing a card. This works on the home screen and in a category. One exception is the Followed Channels row, long press will set the channel as Favorite.
On the cards of the home screen, a category or the search, a preview of the selected stream plays
Favorites in front of Followed streams
Your \'Favorited\'(⭐) channels will be in front of the Followed streams section
case insensitive, separate the names by coma
case insensitive, separate the words by coma
While you watch, a card shows when a followed channel goes live (at most every 2 minutes, 10 seconds long). OK switches, Back stays.
Only with \"Custom URL\" selected. Template with %s for the channel, e.g. https://proxy.lan/hls-raw/%s.m3u8. The proxy has to forward the usher request from an ad-free region.
Color for focus, progress, buttons and chat highlights. OK opens the picker: 30 colors, fine-tuning with Left/Right, or a color code.
Shown on a cold start until the home screen is there. "Logo, name and greeting" adds a glow in the accent color; "Off" shows only the short logo of the system.
Good morning, good evening … with your Twitch name, by the time of day.
Show the splash screen at least
It stays until the home screen has loaded, at least this long, at most 5 s.
First time here, love the setup
Shows the rarely needed settings (timings, 7TV details, MQTT topics, notification looks) and the page "Advanced". Nothing is switched off by hiding it.

Home covers what you see first: start, rows, what to hide, refreshing and card size; the preview on the right shows cards and start screen. Recordings watched to 90 % are dimmed or hidden. The menu key (≡) opens the menu of a card, channel, category or clip, like holding OK; elsewhere it switches the page view or opens \"More\" in the player.
The default quality for live streams and for recordings (VODs), low latency and frame-rate matching. In the player, the Quality button changes it for the stream you are watching.

What the player does with a live stream: the Back to live button, rewinding the live stream, restarting a stalled stream by itself, the replay button and what happens when a stream ends or a raid starts.
Hides messages that start with \"!\" (!lurk, !discord) without also hiding known bots
A dark edge around chat text so it stays readable on any picture
No \"is live\" notices between the two times (also over midnight, e.g. 22:00 to 07:00). Home Assistant still gets the events. Equal times mean the whole day.

Once a day the app asks the ShrugTV release page on GitHub whether a newer version exists and tells you. Without the next setting it downloads and installs nothing; GitHub sees your IP address. Off by default.
Asks right away, ignoring the daily limit
Scan the code to open the release page on your phone, or install it with the Downloader app (code 4727814). Nothing is installed automatically.

Adds the button "Install now" to the update card: the app downloads the new version from GitHub, checks it and opens the installer of the system, where you confirm. Needs the system permission "Install unknown apps" for ShrugTV. Off by default.
Allow ShrugTV to install apps in the next screen, then come back and try again
This TV has no screen for that permission. Enable "Install unknown apps" for ShrugTV in the system settings, or use the Downloader code
This release has no checksum or file for the app. Use the QR code or the Downloader code
The download does not match its checksum and was deleted
Could not check for updates, try again later
Deletes saved pictures, emote images and the saved home screen; they load again when needed
Every changed setting on this page goes back to its default. Secrets such as the MQTT password and the app language stay as they are.
Your design, live: every change shows here and in the whole app at once.

A skin sets all colors, corners, focus and font at once. Picking one clears your own changes below; then adjust single values as you like. Own skins, export and import: in the browser on your phone (Settings → Connections → Phone & browser).
Page behind home screen, rows and settings.
Panels, lists, menus and image placeholders.
LIVE badge and the live mark in the player.
Frame and glow of the selected card or row.
Rounding of cards, buttons, menus and badges, from square to very round.
How the selected card shows: a frame, a soft glow in the focus color, or only growing.
How much the selected card grows.
Width of the frame around the selected card or row.
The see-through buttons and fills, e.g. in the player bar. Off makes them disappear.
How strongly the top picture of the home screen fades behind its text.
Solid, a soft gradient, or a hint of the accent color.
Inter ships with the app; the others come from the device.
All text of the app, on top of the size set on the device.
Off: no fading of pictures and of the splash screen.
Nothing changed, everything comes from the skin
Could not load this. Check the network and try again.
Watched to 90 % or more; on the channel page and in the home rows

One group per home screen row, in the order the home screen shows them. \"Show on the home screen\" switches a row on or off; \"Move up\" moves it one place up, the first row goes to the end. \"Back to the built-in order\" undoes every move. What the clip rows show is set under Home → Clips.

One broadcast language for the app, chosen under \"Select Language\". It feeds the home row \"Top streams in your language\" (Home → Rows), a tab in every category when that switch is on (the switch below opens categories on it), and clips set to \"Only my stream language\".

The skin sets the whole look; colours, shapes, surfaces and text below change single parts of it, and \"From the skin\" follows the skin again. The preview shows each change at once. \"Reset everything to the skin\" removes your own changes. A new app language restarts the settings so every screen switches.

The clock at the top right of the player while its control bar is open. \"Clock format\" (24 or 12 hours) also applies to the rest screen, the date format to the date line. Under \"Local clock\" you switch time and date on or off.

Hides chat messages before they appear: from the users and with the words in the two lists, from bots, or chat commands. \"Hide bots\" catches known bots such as Nightbot, moderators whose name ends in \"bot\", and every command; \"Hide chat commands\" only hides messages that start with \"!\".
Known bots (e.g. Nightbot), moderators whose name ends in \"bot\", and every chat command (!…)
Sends the request for a live stream through a proxy, so the stream comes from a region without ads. \"None\" plays directly; \"Custom URL\" uses your own proxy with the template below.

Only for troubleshooting. Build type, build variant and the user ID (a short hash of your account) help with bug reports. OK six times on Build type leaves developer mode, three times on Build variant opens the debug page.

Version and upkeep: \"Show advanced settings\" shows the rarely needed settings and the group \"Advanced\", \"Clear caches\" frees pictures and the saved home screen. Where this edition looks for updates, its switches are here too. OK six times on the version code turns on developer mode.
Off: ShrugTV joins no chat, live or in recordings, and the chat settings below have no effect
Off: the chat runs hidden, you open it in the player
